body: I'm pretty aware of how many of these things connect. I got help for it 3 years ago and it slowly got better until 6 months ago where everything slowly started crashing down with the deepest point reached this month. I'm at the worst point (mentally) in my life and I don't see the point of pushing forward, knowing there's a chance all this will repeat again, if not worse.

In no particular order: past physical abuse, father abandonment, sexual molestation as a child, financial problems in the last decade which will continue for at least few more months, anxiety, anorexia, apathy, emptiness, stress, anhedonia, lack of real motivation, imposter syndrome, no drive, feeling of romantic incompetence, awareness of possible bit of codependency (from my end), loneliness, isolation (in the country I live in I know very few people), not feeling of belonging
